title: Moving Average
text: Moving average-value computation, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Fundamental frequency (Hz)} sets the signal fundamental frequency, {Initial value} sets the initial input signal value and {Buffer size} sets the size of buffer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Fundamental frequency (Hz)
params.values: Signal fundamental frequency 60 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values
